arguments.premise_synthesis: Kevin Worsh, despite past criticisms of Fed policy, is expected to follow a pattern of supporting measures he helped start during the financial crisis. Fed Governor Steven Moran has recently advocated for bank deregulation, aligning with this plan. Historical precedent from 2020–2021 shows that temporarily removing the supplementary leverage ratio allowed banks to absorb large volumes of Treasuries, lowering yields. Bank deregulation and balance sheet remix would similarly enable the Fed to normalize while banks absorb government debt, with coordination between Treasury Secretary Bessent and Fed Chair Worsh being essential to execute the accord.
